Matt Root's Birthday Jam

Description
Bring your instruments and get ready for a night of live music, good company, and plenty of jamming at Brix Wine & Whiskey! Join the fun on Friday, November 6th, at 8 PM as Brix celebrates Matt Root's birthday the best way they know how – with music! Musicians of all skill levels are invited to join in, share their talents, and groove together. Whether you're ready to play or just enjoy the music, come be part of the fun! For more information, visit https://www.facebook.com/events/1821587859046084.
